name: BoxIcons v2
about: BoxIcons v2 is a free, open-source icon set with 2,423 icons designed by Boxicons. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.q: Are BoxIcons v2 free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 2,423 BoxIcons v2 are open source under the MIT license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the MIT terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use BoxIcons v2 in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many BoxIcons v2 are there?
faqs.a: There are 2,423 icons in the BoxIcons v2 set, designed by Boxicons. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of BoxIcons v2?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are BoxIcons v2 available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
